body.input: [T6c#2 wakeUp-repeat] Call the cortex-write tool with path='/memories/cb-wakeup-repeat-test' and content='wakeup-repeat-test-payload' and callbackMode='wakeUp'. Two valid outcomes: (a) DEFERRED - you get a taskId and no responsePath yet → end with STEP_OK; OR (b) INLINE - a fast task returns the result immediately (a non-empty responsePath) → end with WAKEUP_OK. Either is correct. Only end with FAILED: <reason> if you get neither a taskId nor a responsePath. If you got a taskId (deferred), you will be revived when the write is done - on revival confirm the deferred result contains a non-empty responsePath and end with WAKEUP_OK, or WAKEUP_FAILED: <reason> if no responsePath appears.
